posts.author: SylarDean
posts.body:
Maybe  make the player invincible with the HP70% as a condition?
Then on next turn turn the invincible off ?
OR maybe "an out-of-the-box" thought..
Create an invisible state with no icon.. that makes the player invincible when hp is 70%, set it so it lasts to end of round. Have the state apply to your character(s) by using a check run through the entire battle on the TROOPS tab. This might be an option for you.
